company.description: Scribd, Inc. is an AI-powered knowledge company. Our products leverage the world's largest collection of human-created content and intelligent tools to help people move from information access to real understanding and application. We built our portfolio to serve every stage of that journey: Scribd’s knowledge platform, Slideshare’s professional presentations,  Everand’s expansive library, and Fable’s social reading experience. Scribd, Inc. brings together what no one else can: proprietary content, human-in-the-loop tools, and intelligence that compounds with every interaction

aiResearchSummary.text: Scribd is researching semantic content clustering based on user interactions, as described in systems where a Topic Engine captures sequences of content identifiers reflecting user access patterns to organize content. Additionally, Scribd is developing archive offer personalization, where an Offer Engine extracts features from user data to tailor access to content. These areas focus on enhancing content organization and personalized content delivery.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $58,000,000, or 54.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $35,792,438 to $542,293,466, a 15.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Docdroid, Issuu, Readcube.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
